summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust (WHLR) disclosed a Note Purchase Agreement dated October 13, 2026 with an unaffiliated investor for a $1,000,000 promissory note, part of a program permitting up to $25,000,000 aggregate principal in $1,000,000 denominations issued on identical terms. Notes mature 18 months from issuance and bear 0.00% interest, with conversion into common stock (Amortization Stock) subject to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d) stockholder approval of issuances exceeding 19.99% of outstanding shares and registration statement effectiveness. Closings occur within five business days of satisfying both conditions. Structure is effectively a zero-coupon convertible financing creating dilution overhang; watch stockholder vote timing, registration effectiveness, and any actual note issuances toward the $25M cap.
